question: Should ClawHub reject only case-colliding package paths while continuing to accept a lone lowercase `skill.md` or `protocol.md`, or enforce canonical uppercase filenames for all new publishes?
rationale: The documented format accepts a lowercase manifest alias, the linked issue asks for uppercase enforcement, and the patch deliberately chooses a narrower compatibility-preserving rule; tests cannot determine the intended product contract.

options.title: Reject collisions only
options.body: Preserve lowercase-only packages and reject only ambiguous paths that collide on case-insensitive filesystems.

options.title: Enforce canonical uppercase
options.body: Require uppercase canonical filenames for new publishes and define migration behavior for existing lowercase-only packages.

recommendation.title: Reject collisions only
recommendation.body: Preserve lowercase-only packages and reject only ambiguous paths that collide on case-insensitive filesystems.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged recent work on the same GitHub import and publish boundary and are the best-supported available owner for the compatibility choice.
